title: Veiled Figure in Cosmic Ruins
description: A nude woman with glowing skin crouches in shallow reflective water, partially covered by a dark blue cloak adorned with golden runes. She is surrounded by ancient stone ruins, a twisted sword-like structure with black branches, floating pink petals, and a starry night sky featuring a large dark moon with a golden corona.
prompt: A mystical nude woman with luminous skin crouches in a shallow pool of reflective water at night, draped in a dark blue cloak with glowing golden runes and symbols. She is positioned between ancient Greek-style stone ruins on the left and a tall twisted sword structure wrapped in black thorny branches on the right. Pink cherry blossom petals float through the air and on the water's surface. The dramatic sky contains stars, constellations, clouds, and a large dark celestial body with a bright golden glowing corona. Ethereal and melancholic fantasy atmosphere.
